name: vault-bridge
description: Obsidian vault ↔ project bridge for Claude Code: manifest cache, read-only vault-searcher agent (haiku), Stop/SessionEnd/SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks, and slash commands (/save-session, /vault-link, /vault-commit, /save-plan-doc, /handoff, /vault-manifest-refresh) with .vault-link project binding and write-role contract.

vault_path.title: Vault Path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault root (e.g. ~/vault or /Users/me/my-vault). Exposed to hooks as VAULT_BRIDGE_VAULT_PATH. Use VAULT_BRIDGE_VAULT_ROOT env var to override at runtime.

hooks.prompt: Session close. Write safety-net session-note INLINE — never delegate to vault-searcher Mode 4, never call AskUserQuestion. (1) Skip if trivial (<3 turns or pure Q&A, no edits/reads/decisions/exec). (2) State: Bash(`SID=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}"|tr -cd A-Za-z0-9_-); F=/tmp/vault-bridge-session-$SID/session-end-state.json; cat $F 2>/dev/null`). Empty/disabled → gates off, still write. (3) Path: use `vault_root` from state JSON (field `.vault_root`) + `/inbox/session-YYYY-MM-DD.md`; fall back to `~/vault/inbox/` if state unavailable. Append -v2/-v3 on collision. (4) Write. Frontmatter exactly: `created`, `tags: [session, auto-saved]`, `type: session` (no `status`). Body: `## Summary` (2-3 lines) + `## Related Files`. (5) `direct_access_count>0` → append `## Notes` — 'Direct vault access: N times (use vault-searcher next session for ~97% token savings).' (6) `plan_docs.auto_capture_active && !already_asked && candidates` → append `## Plan Doc Sync` — 'Plan docs detected. Run /save-plan-doc to snapshot.' Then Bash(`touch $(jq -r .session_state_dir $F)/plan-doc-asked 2>/dev/null`). (7) Bash(`rm -rf /tmp/vault-bridge-session-$SID 2>/dev/null`).
